topic: Queued tasks under the enforcing guard
detail: SP-041's hook decides from a session pin file, and queued tasks have no session pin (PinSession is refused to them), so while spaces are applied and the guard enforces, every tool call of a queued task is refused (pin_missing). Proposed: orchd writes a task pin file keyed by ORCH_TASK_ID when it starts a run, with the space D-46 gives (the dispatching session's space; the operator's task takes its working directory's placement), which needs Dispatch to record the caller's pin. Until then, queued work stops when spaces are applied with the guard enforcing.
